_reference_rationale: The witness op's numerical contract is IDENTITY PASS-THROUGH of the b2e stream (plan section 15.3 item 1c: 'returns b2e pass-through'). The reference is torch clone — outside the port package. The instrument value (device_print emission) is deliberately NOT a graded numerics quantity: prints are side effects the comparison venues cannot observe; their proof venue is P-B (transport) and the production leg's FAL-2/W-readings (in-graph delivery). What numerics MUST grade is that wiring the witness cannot perturb the value stream it witnesses: output bitwise-equal to input.
_tolerance_rationale: rtol=0, atol=0: identity on int32 is exact by construction; any nonzero tolerance would let a sanitizing witness pass, and a witness that sanitizes (clamps/rounds) the very values it exists to observe is the one defect class this declaration must kill. NEVER widened.
_case_rationale: in_domain: the production shape s32[11] with values in [0,3]. out_of_domain: the witness must pass through ARBITRARY int32 bit patterns unmodified — this is the boundary case that matters for THIS op (a garbled device-side stream is exactly what W2 would observe; the witness must never launder it). sentinel_only: the fallback-budget variant (plan section 15.3 item 3) is a distinct traced form and gets its own case. boundary_all_max_expert: constant-valued stream (ones), the degenerate routing case. The out-of-envelope-input->fallback leg is exercised by the gate check (int64 input refuses the kernel), covered in the triad's gate tests, not a numerics case: dtype mismatch is a dispatch fact, not a tolerance fact.
